answers.cutoff_control_reason: no older TILT3REACH-* raw face on disk: the only published face carries this same cutoff, so a stale-face control has nothing to compare against yet (null means 'not measurable', not 'clean')
answers.reading: the repair reaches the three-member attribution: 18 of 137 cells move (17 era / 0 skin / 1 answer / 0 other), eras touched=['2021_2023', '2024_now', 'full'], tilt-sign flips=[], 1 of 20 arrow claims move and 0 era(s) no longer decompose; 0 cell(s) exist on one arm only

honest: both arms are burnt off ONE load of the panel so the twin differs in the repair, not in what was read
the per-era table is the answer face: a constant shift across eras leaves the attribution intact while a single-era shift rewrites it
a tilt-sign flip is published as its own list because a sign is the headline a reader consumes ('small caps led') and a magnitude delta cannot express it
skin rows compare 3-, 4- and 5-member readings on shared months only; the delta is the composition price, not the identity
the cutoff control holds the arm fixed (raw vs raw) so a stale face is separated from a repair effect
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count
